meta.segment: Low-income households - students, farmers, senior citizens, daily-wage and unorganised workers
meta.curated_by: Team SchemeSetu (Codebenders ACE Builders Hackathon 2026, Problem Statement 5)
meta.disclaimer: Rules are stored as editable data, curated from publicly available official sources on the dates shown. Scheme rules change often. SchemeSetu says 'likely eligible' - never a guarantee. Always confirm on the official portal before applying, and never share Aadhaar numbers or OTPs with anyone.
meta.data_quality_policy: Every scheme carries source_url, source_name and verified_on. provenance=EXTRACTED means the rule was read from the official source page; INFERRED means we derived it (e.g. from a press release or circular); AMBIGUOUS means the rule changed recently and a human must re-verify.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.summary: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 into the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Rs 6,000 per year (3 instalments of Rs 2,000)
schemes.portal_name: PM-KISAN portal (Ministry of Agriculture)
apply_steps: Keep your land record (Pahani / Record of Rights) and bank passbook ready.
Open pmkisan.gov.in and choose 'New Farmer Registration'.
Fill state, district and the land-record details. Enter the Aadhaar number only on the official portal - never in a third-party app or with a middleman.
Complete e-KYC at the nearest CSC or through the portal.
Save the registration number and check 'Know Your Status' after 2-3 weeks.

deadline.note: Registration is continuous; instalments follow the cut-off dates announced per cycle.

schemes.summary: Cashless hospital treatment cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals, for families identified as deprived or holding a white ration card.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year, cashless at empanelled hospitals
schemes.portal_name: NHA Ayushman Bharat beneficiary portal
apply_steps: Check whether your family is on the beneficiary list - on the Ayushman portal, or at the nearest CSC / Aarogyasri office.
Generate the Ayushman card using the family identity proof and ration card.
At hospital admission, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk.
Keep the discharge summary and treatment papers for your own records.

deadline.note: No deadline - check eligibility and generate the card any time.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC students (Class 9-10)
schemes.summary: Scholarship for SC students in Class 9 and 10, covering a monthly maintenance allowance and books grant, to stop dropout after Class 8.
schemes.benefit: Monthly maintenance allowance + books / ad-hoc grant (rates differ for day-scholars and hostellers)
schemes.portal_name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
apply_steps: Get your SC caste certificate and family income certificate first - both are compulsory.
Register on scholarships.gov.in (or through the Telangana ePASS portal for state-linked scholarships).
Upload the marksheet, bonafide certificate and bank passbook.
Submit before the NSP closing date and note down the application ID.
The institute and the state welfare department verify the application - track the status on the portal.

deadline.note: NSP usually closes around end October; the exact date is announced each year on the portal.

Studying in Class 9 or Class 10

Parental annual income within the scheme ceiling (Rs 2.5 lakh)
rules.source_note: Income ceiling as printed in the NSP scheme guidelines

documents.label: SC caste certificate
documents.how_to_get: Apply on the Telangana MeeSeva portal or at your district e-District office.

documents.label: Family income certificate
documents.how_to_get: MeeSeva / Dharani is the fastest route.

documents.label: Bank passbook in the student's own name

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC students
schemes.summary: Scholarship for SC students who passed Class 10 and are studying in Class 11, ITI, polytechnic, degree or professional courses, with maintenance, fee and book grants.
schemes.benefit: Maintenance allowance + non-refundable fees + books grant, disbursed through the institute
schemes.portal_name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
apply_steps: Confirm your institute is registered on NSP (most government colleges are).
Complete NSP registration and link a bank account enabled for DBT.
Upload the caste certificate, income certificate, Class 10/12 marksheet and fee receipt.
Track the institute and state verification stages on your portal dashboard.

deadline.note: Announced per academic year; renew before the portal closes.

rules.text: Belongs to a Scheduled Caste
Studying in Class 11 or above (or a post-Class-10 course)
Applicant is currently studying
Family income within the ceiling (Rs 2.5 lakh)
Low-income household

documents.label: Admission / fee receipt from the institute

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
schemes.summary: Rs 12,000 a year for meritorious Class 9-12 students from low-income families, selected through the NMMS test taken in Class 8.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,000 per month (Rs 12,000 a year) from Class 9 to Class 12
schemes.portal_name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - NMMSS
apply_steps: In Class 8, appear for the state-level NMMS selection test (your school announces it).
Score at least 55% in Class 8 (50% for SC/ST students).
After selection, register on scholarships.gov.in and renew the scholarship every year.
Keep at least 60% marks in later classes to continue receiving it.

deadline.note: Test and renewal windows are announced each year.

rules.text: Applicant is a school student
Studying in Class 9 to Class 12
Family income within Rs 3.5 lakh (revised ceiling)
Usually a government / local-body / aided school student

schemes.name: Telangana ePASS - Reimbursement of Tuition Fee (RTF)
schemes.summary: Full tuition fee reimbursement for SC/ST/BC/EBC/Minority students of Telangana studying degree, engineering, polytechnic and other post-matric courses, plus hostel and mess charges where applicable.
schemes.benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement for the approved course duration
schemes.portal_name: Telangana ePASS
apply_steps: Get the caste certificate and income certificate issued in Telangana (MeeSeva).
Register on the Telangana ePASS portal with your SSC / Intermediate hall ticket number.
Choose 'Fee Reimbursement' and fill the course and institute details.
Submit and take a printout; the college then verifies and forwards it.
Track the sanction status on ePASS - the amount is credited to the college / your account.

deadline.note: The ePASS window opens with the admission season and closes around mid-November.

rules.text: Student is a resident of Telangana
Currently studying in a recognised institution
Post-matric course (Intermediate or above)
SC / ST / BC / EBC / Minority category
Family income within the RTF ceiling
rules.source_note: Ceilings differ by course - the portal shows the applicable limit

schemes.name: Telangana Aasara Pension - Old Age
schemes.summary: Monthly social security pension for senior citizens of Telangana who do not have another pension, credited by DBT on the first of every month.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension of about Rs 2,016 credited by DBT (rate is revised from time to time)
schemes.portal_name: Telangana Aasara pensions portal / Gram Panchayat or MRO office
apply_steps: Collect the application form from the Gram Panchayat / Ward office, or apply online on the Aasara pensions portal.
Attach the age proof, residence proof and bank passbook.
The Gram Panchayat verifies and forwards it to the MRO / Tahsildar.
After sanction, the pension is credited to your bank account on the 1st of each month.
If the pension stops, ask at the MeeSeva / MRO office - it is usually a bank or Aadhaar re-verification.

deadline.note: Applications are accepted through the year; sanctions are processed monthly.

schemes.provenance_note: The monthly pension rate has been revised repeatedly at state budget time. The eligibility rules below are stable, but the amount must be re-verified against the latest state order before quoting it to a citizen.

Bank account for DBT credit

documents.label: Age proof (Aadhaar, voter ID or school certificate)
Residence proof of the Telangana address

schemes.name: Telangana Aasara Pension - Widow
schemes.summary: Monthly pension for widows in Telangana aged 18 and above from low-income households, credited by DBT.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension of about Rs 2,016 credited by DBT (rate revised from time to time)

apply_steps: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Ward office, or on the Aasara pensions portal.
Attach the spouse's death certificate, age proof, ration card and bank passbook.
Verification happens at the Gram Panchayat / MRO level.
Pension is credited on the 1st of every month after sanction.

deadline.note: Open through the year.

schemes.provenance_note: Pension rate is revised at state budget time; the eligibility criteria below are stable.

schemes.name: Telangana Aasara Pension - Persons with Disability
schemes.summary: Higher-rate monthly pension for persons with disability in Telangana, plus a free bus pass and other concessions, credited by DBT.
schemes.benefit: Monthly disability pension (a higher rate than the old-age rate) credited by DBT
schemes.portal_name: Telangana Aasara pensions portal / SADAREM / MRO office
apply_steps: Get the SADAREM disability assessment done (district SADAREM camp or hospital).
Apply at the Gram Panchayat / MRO office with the SADAREM certificate and bank passbook.
Ask about the free travel pass and any assistive-device scheme at the same office.
After sanction, the pension is credited monthly by DBT.

deadline.note: Open through the year; SADAREM camps are held district-wise.

schemes.provenance_note: Disability pension rate is revised at state budget time - re-verify before quoting the amount.

Age 18 years or above
Resident of Telangana

Bank account for DBT credit

documents.label: SADAREM disability certificate

schemes.name: Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak marriage assistance
schemes.summary: One-time financial assistance for the marriage of a bride from a poor household in Telangana, paid to the bride's bank account through the ePASS portal.
schemes.benefit: One-time assistance of about Rs 1,00,116 for the bride of an eligible household
schemes.portal_name: Telangana ePASS (Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak)
apply_steps: Register on the ePASS portal under Kalyana Lakshmi before or around the marriage date.
Attach the bride's age proof, caste and income certificates, the wedding invitation card and the bride's bank passbook.
The application goes to the district welfare officer for verification.
The sanctioned amount is credited to the bride's own bank account - so open or link her account first.
Apply early: late applications need special approval and are often rejected.

deadline.note: Apply before the wedding date; submissions after the marriage are usually rejected unless the district officer allows a late case.

schemes.source_name: Telangana ePASS - Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak

White ration card / BPL household, or income proof within the limit

schemes.name: Rythu Bharosa investment support (Telangana)
schemes.summary: Season-wise investment support paid by the Telangana government to farmer families for every acre they cultivate, credited directly before the sowing season.
schemes.benefit: Season-wise per-acre investment support for cultivated land (rate set by the state order)
schemes.portal_name: Telangana agriculture portal / Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO)
apply_steps: Ensure your land details in Dharani match the land you actually cultivate.
Check the passbook entry / bank statement after the season's release.
If the amount has not arrived, contact your village Agriculture Extension Officer with the Pahani copy.
For leased-in land, keep the lease agreement ready - it is needed to update the record.
Update any change of bank account or Aadhaar seeding before the season cut-off.

deadline.note: Two windows a year, ahead of the kharif and rabi seasons.

schemes.provenance_note: The per-acre rate and the scheme name have changed across state orders; the land and residency rules are stable but the rate must be re-checked.

Bank account for the DBT credit
Not an income-tax paying household (exclusion rule)

documents.label: Bank passbook showing the DBT credit
Aadhaar (masked) linked to the bank account

schemes.name: Telangana Aarogyasri health scheme
schemes.summary: Cashless treatment for listed diseases and surgeries at network hospitals for white ration card families of Telangana, beyond the PM-JAY cover.
schemes.benefit: Cashless treatment up to the scheme limit per family per year at network hospitals
schemes.portal_name: Telangana Aarogyasri Health Care Trust
apply_steps: Carry the white ration card and the Aarogyasri / Ayushman card to the hospital.
At the hospital, go to the Aarogyasri help desk before admission to get pre-authorisation.
For a listed procedure the hospital files the claim - you pay nothing if it is covered.
Keep the discharge summary and the sanction slip for follow-up treatment.
If the hospital refuses, call the Aarogyasri helpline number printed on the card.

deadline.note: No deadline - cover is available through the year at network hospitals.

rules.text: Family is a resident of Telangana
Holds a ration card (white / low-income card is required)
Low-income household
Cover applies to the whole family

documents.label: Aarogyasri / Ayushman card
documents.how_to_get: Generate at the nearest Aarogyasri office or MeeSeva with the ration card.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
schemes.summary: Low-premium crop insurance for farmers: if the crop fails because of drought, flood, pests or unseasonal rain, the claim is paid to the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Sum insured based on the crop and area; farmer pays only 1.5-2% of the premium
schemes.portal_name: PMFBY portal / bank, CSC or Agriculture Extension Officer
apply_steps: Sow the crop first - enrolment is allowed only before the notified cut-off date.
Enrol at the bank where the crop loan is taken, or at a CSC, or on pmfby.gov.in.
Keep the sowing certificate and land record (Pahani) handy.
For loanee farmers the bank enrols you automatically - check the premium debit.
If the crop is damaged, inform the bank / agriculture office within 72 hours and keep photographs.

deadline.note: Separate cut-off dates for kharif and rabi seasons are notified each year.

Occupation is farming
Farming household in a rural area
Bank account for claim settlement

documents.label: Sowing certificate from the village agriculture officer
Bank passbook linked for the claim
Crop loan / KCC papers (if enrolled through the bank)

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (rural housing)
schemes.summary: Financial help in instalments to build a pucca house for rural households that have no house or only a kucha house, with toilet and water connection support.
schemes.benefit: Assistance of about Rs 1.2 lakh in instalments (plus toilet and MGNREGA wage support)
schemes.portal_name: AwaasSoft / Gram Panchayat
apply_steps: Check the permanent wait list in AwaasSoft at your Gram Panchayat - priority is by deprivation score.
Give the bank account, Aadhaar-seeded details and the job card number to the Gram Panchayat.
The house is geo-tagged in stages; each stage releases the next instalment.
Photographs at plinth, lintel and roof level are mandatory for instalments.
Do the work through MGNREGA (mate/bill system) to also earn wage support.

deadline.note: Selection is from the permanent wait list; the list is reviewed each year.

rules.text: Rural household
Does not already own a pucca house
Low-income / deprived household
Currently homeless, in a kucha house or renting
Bank account for the instalments

schemes.name: Telangana Double Bedroom Housing (2BHK)
schemes.summary: Free 2BHK flats in multi-storey colonies for poor and homeless families of Telangana, allotted by the housing department through a draw.
schemes.benefit: A free 2BHK flat (about 560 sq ft) in a government housing colony
schemes.portal_name: Telangana Housing Department / MeeSeva
apply_steps: Watch for the notification in your municipality or Gram Panchayat.
Apply with the ration card and income proof - a beneficiary survey is also conducted.
Attach the Aadhaar-seeded bank details and the existing house photo (if any).
Selection is by lottery / draw; the list is published and displayed locally.
After allotment the flat is registered in the beneficiary's name after a 10-year lock-in.

deadline.note: Allotments follow state notifications; watch the housing department site.

schemes.provenance_note: Eligibility conditions are derived from state housing department notifications; the notification wording changes per phase.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (NSAP)
schemes.summary: Central monthly pension for BPL persons aged 60 and above, in addition to any state top-up, credited to the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Central share of the monthly old-age pension, plus the state government's top-up
schemes.portal_name: NSAP portal / Gram Panchayat, MRO or MeeSeva centre
apply_steps: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / MRO office or through the state pensions portal.
Attach the age proof, BPL / ration card proof and bank passbook.
The state then uploads the sanction to the NSAP portal.
If the pension stops, ask for the annual life certificate / Aadhaar re-verification.

deadline.note: Applications are received through the year and sanctioned monthly.

rules.text: Age 60 years or above
Household below the poverty line
Not already drawing another government pension for the same purpose
BPL / ration card proof
Bank or post-office account for DBT

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (girl child savings)
schemes.summary: Small-savings account for a girl child below 10 years, with the highest government-set interest rate and tax-free maturity for her education or marriage.
schemes.benefit: Government-backed savings account at the notified rate (currently the best small-savings rate) for 21 years
schemes.portal_name: Any post office or authorised bank branch
apply_steps: Visit a post office or bank branch with the girl's birth certificate.
Fill the account-opening form and deposit the minimum amount (Rs 250).
Attach the guardian's identity and address proof.
Deposit every year - the maximum is Rs 1.5 lakh per year.
Partial withdrawal is allowed for higher education after she turns 18.

deadline.note: Open any time before the girl turns 10.

rules.text: A daughter below 10 years in the family
An account in the child's or guardian's name to manage it
Most useful for households that can save a little each year

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (free LPG connection)
schemes.summary: A free LPG gas connection with the first refill and stove subsidy for women from poor households, so cooking does not happen on firewood.
schemes.benefit: Free LPG connection: deposit waived, first refill and stove included
schemes.portal_name: PMUY portal / nearest LPG distributor
apply_steps: Go to the nearest Indane / HP / Bharat gas distributor with the ration card and identity proof.
Fill the Ujjwala form - the deposit is waived under the scheme.
Give the bank account details for the refill subsidy.
Collect the connection and complete the KYC for a second cylinder if needed.

deadline.note: Open through the year at any LPG distributor.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Shishu loan
schemes.summary: Collateral-free bank loan up to Rs 50,000 for a small shop, tailoring unit, food cart or any micro-enterprise, with no processing fee in the Shishu category.
schemes.benefit: Loan up to Rs 50,000 (Shishu) with no collateral; larger Kisht and Tarun categories available
schemes.portal_name: Any bank / RRB / MFI branch, or the Jan Samarth portal
apply_steps: Decide the business and write a one-page rough plan (what you buy, what you sell, expected daily sales).
Approach your bank or an MFI with the MUDRA application form.
Give identity, address and the quotation for machinery / stock.
For Shishu no collateral is needed - do not pay any agent.
Repay on time: on-time repayment makes the next, bigger loan easier.

deadline.note: Applications are accepted at any time through banks.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi - street vendor working capital loan
schemes.summary: Working-capital loan of Rs 10,000 (then Rs 20,000 and Rs 50,000 on timely repayment) for street vendors, with interest subsidy and digital-transaction cashback.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10,000 first loan, escalating to Rs 20,000 and Rs 50,000, with 7% interest subsidy
schemes.portal_name: PM SVANidhi portal / Urban Local Body (municipal office)
apply_steps: Get a certificate of vending or a letter of recommendation from the Urban Local Body / market association.
Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or at your municipal office / CSC.
Choose a bank branch; the ticket number tracks the application.
Repay within the year to become eligible for the next higher loan.
Use UPI for sales to earn the monthly cash-back.

deadline.note: Open through the year; new rounds are announced by the ministry.

schemes.source_name: PM SVANidhi official portal (Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs)

schemes.name: e-Shram registration for unorganised workers
schemes.summary: Free national registration card for unorganised and gig workers, giving accident insurance cover and a single identity used to claim several other benefits.
schemes.benefit: e-Shram card with Rs 2 lakh accident cover and access to welfare schemes

Register on eshram.gov.in or at a CSC (nominal fee at a CSC).
Choose your occupation and skill category honestly - it decides which schemes you can be mapped to.
Download the e-Shram card and keep a printed copy.
Update the mobile number or address if it ever changes.

deadline.note: Registration is continuous and free on the portal.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma (artisan toolkit and loan)
schemes.summary: Skill training, Rs 15,000 toolkit grant, and collateral-free loans at 5% interest for traditional artisans and craftspeople like weavers, potters, carpenters and tailors.
schemes.benefit: Rs 15,000 toolkit voucher + loans up to Rs 3 lakh at 5% interest + daily training stipend
schemes.portal_name: PM Vishwakarma portal / CSC / Gram Panchayat
apply_steps: Register on pmvishwakarma.gov.in with Aadhaar and bank details (or through a CSC).
The Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body verifies that you actually work in the trade.
Attend the basic skill training (you get a stipend for those days).
Take the toolkit voucher, then apply for the first loan tranche.
Repay on time to unlock the second loan tranche at the same low rate.

deadline.note: Registration and verification happen continuously.

schemes.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (life cover)
schemes.summary: Life insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh for a very small yearly premium, auto-debited from the bank account - especially important for the earning member of a daily-wage family.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2 lakh life cover for about Rs 436 per year
schemes.portal_name: Your bank branch / net banking (Jan Suraksha)
apply_steps: Ask your bank to enrol you in PMJJBY (or give consent on the form).
Keep enough balance in the account for the yearly auto-debit.
Give the nominee's name while enrolling.
On a claim, the nominee approaches the bank with the death certificate.

deadline.note: Enrol any time; the premium is debited once a year (usually 31 May).

schemes.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (accident cover)
schemes.summary: Accident insurance of Rs 2 lakh (Rs 1 lakh for partial disability) for about Rs 20 a year - the cheapest cover available to a worker who rides or works with tools.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2 lakh accident cover for about Rs 20 per year
schemes.portal_name: Your bank branch / net banking (Jan Suraksha)
apply_steps: Opt in at your bank or through net banking.
Keep a small balance for the yearly auto-debit.
For a claim, submit the accident report / FIR and hospital papers to the bank.
Claims must be filed within 30 days of the accident.

deadline.note: Enrol any time; the premium is debited once a year.

schemes.name: Ayushman Vay Vandana card (health cover for 70+)
schemes.summary: Cashless hospital cover of Rs 5 lakh per year for every person aged 70 and above, regardless of income, given through a simple Ayushman card.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh per year cashless hospital cover for each person aged 70+
schemes.portal_name: NHA beneficiary portal / CSC / Ayushman Mitra
apply_steps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in and choose the 70+ (Vay Vandana) option.
Complete e-KYC with the Aadhaar-linked mobile number (no income proof needed).
